description_en: Local placeholder agency scheme of the World Bank declaring the sub-agency AFW360, so that the agency WB.AFW360 resolves. Never submitted to a registry; replaced by the World Bank's own scheme at registration.
notes: Fixed version 1.0 as the XSD requires (D31).

description_en: One concept per component of the household indicator data structure and per reference metadata attribute.
notes: Metadata attribute concepts come from metadata/structure/COLUMNS.csv.

description_en: Structure of the household welfare indicator data: 18 dimensions, a time dimension, 9 measures and 6 attributes.
Poverty and welfare indicators from household surveys and models for West and Central African countries, by area, sex, age, urbanisation and other breakdowns.
Reference metadata attributes describing surveys, sources, texts and figures.
Reference metadata for the survey, source and figure codelists and for the household indicators dataflow.
Data providers of the AFW 360 household indicators: the AFW DIP/POV team.
notes: Fixed version 1.0 as the XSD requires.

description_en: Links the household indicators dataflow to its data provider AFW_POV.
Providers of the AFW 360 reference metadata: the AFW DIP/POV team.
notes: Fixed version 1.0 as the XSD requires.

description_en: Links the reference metadataflow to its metadata provider AFW_POV.
Age bands of the individual counted.
Countries covered by the database: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 codes.
Variables by which an indicator can be broken down, such as consumption quintile; each groups categories of the breakdown codelist.
Categories of the breakdown variables used in the five breakdown dimensions.
How a value was produced: directly from a survey or by a model.
Frequency of the observations; aligned to the SDMX frequency codelist.
Subnational areas of each country, such as regions, departments and agro-ecological zones.
Geographic partitions of each country, such as first-level administrative units and agro-ecological zones.
notes: Code ids are ref_area and code joined by an underscore (for example SEN_ADM1).

description_en: Indicators of poverty, welfare and household characteristics, with their statistical definition.
Status of an observation value; aligned to the SDMX observation status codelist.
Variables that qualify what an indicator measures, such as the poverty line; each groups values of the qualifier codelist.
Values of the qualifier variables used in the five measure qualifier dimensions.
Sex of the individual counted; aligned to the SDMX sex codelist.
Units an indicator counts or describes, such as persons or households.
Statistics an indicator computes, such as a share, mean or count, and whether each admits a standard error.
Themes that group the indicators on the dashboard.
Units in which observation values are expressed; includes ISO 4217 currency codes of the covered countries.
notes: Renamed in 0.3.0 to match the id of the IAEG-SDGs unit list; the 0.2.0 file was the project unit list.

description_en: Urban and rural areas of residence, with the capital city and other urban areas as children of urban.
Survey weights used to compute the indicators.
Sources of the data: one code per program run that produced observations.
Household surveys from which the indicators are computed.
Static figures shown on the dashboard.
